item.title: lidang 立党 （劝人卖房/学CS/买SP500/纳100/OpenAI/Anthrop第一人） 胖东来现在陷入一个两难的境地：所有美妆洗护类的产品，几乎都
item.description:
lidang 立党 （劝人卖房/学CS/买SP500/纳100/OpenAI/Anthrop第一人）
胖东来现在陷入一个两难的境地：所有美妆洗护类的产品，几乎都是假牌子，山寨假进口牌子，一瓶一两百，是胖东来的最大利润品类，是胖东来真正的暴利品，

河南人认知低、素质低、学历低，在河南卖得还特别好，但是一旦拿出来，让一线城市看一眼，就全戳穿了，发现跟一个山寨小卖铺一样，全是垃圾货。

但最大的问题是，胖东来自己的员工绝大多数也是河南人，非常乡土，屁也不懂，没见过大世面，基本也不懂什么美妆洗护类产品，考察了一大圈，只能选出这些垃圾牌子。

但你让胖东来彻底砍掉所有美妆洗护类产品，又失去了利润的主要来源，尤其胖东来正在扩张的时期，仅仅靠你自己的那点豆芽、榴莲、炒菜、大米、豆油，不挣点快钱把现金流拉起来，是支撑不起来的。

胖东来最好的出路，就是离开许昌，进入一线城市，只做生鲜熟食和生活用品，让一线城市的消费者拉高溢价，但是一线城市有Sams Club，有costco，有Aldi，胖东来进去又是纯纯找死。
tweet

item.title: Daily Dose of Data Science GPU vs. RDU, clearly explained: (RDUs provide 4x fast
item.description:
Daily Dose of Data Science
GPU vs. RDU, clearly explained:

(RDUs provide 4x faster LLM inference)

A GPU can have plenty of compute available and still generate LLM tokens slowly.

During decode, particularly at small batch sizes, moving weights and intermediate results can take longer than the arithmetic itself.

A typical GPU implementation runs a decoder layer through multiple kernels for operations such as normalization, attention, and the MLP.

Between kernels, intermediate results may be written to high-bandwidth memory and read back. Launch overhead and synchronization also introduce gaps before useful work resumes.

Kernel fusion reduces those boundaries. GPUs can even run entire forward passes as megakernels, although coordinating memory, execution, and synchronization requires specialized engineering.

The hardware question becomes whether those operations can communicate directly through on-chip memory while weight loading overlaps computation.

SambaNova's RDU, or Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit, is designed around that approach.

Its compiler maps connected operations onto different compute units and streams intermediate results between them through on-chip SRAM.

HBM still supplies weights and stores the KV cache. The aim is to reduce intermediate memory traffic and keep data moving through the computation.

The tradeoff is greater dependence on compiler mapping and the model's execution graph. Actual speed still depends on model size, precision, batching, and the hardware configuration.

We wrote a detailed breakdown of how RDUs work, covering dataflow execution, memory tiers, multi-chip communication, and separating prefill from decode. It also includes a hands-on inference test.

Read it below.

https://t.co/XrIWxkwSxz - Avi Chawla
tweet

item.description:

玩了一下这个DS Bot，搭配deepseek的最低档的模型

跑跑琐碎的任务流程 还是可以 不是很token https://t.co/3LFwuLYblN

DS Bot：把多个 AI Agent 组织成一个团队的开源协作工具。

基于 DeepSeek Harness，通过 Chief 统一协调不同 AI 助手，支持 Bot 群聊、@任务委派、Goal 目标管理、独立记忆和工作目录。

还能接入已有的 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Cursor CLI 等本地编程 Agent。

和偏向云端 AI 员工服务的 Grok Bot 不同，DS Bot 更侧重本地 Agent 的组织与协作，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 桌面端及 Docker 自托管部署。

Apache 2.0 开源，软件免费，模型费用自理，多 Bot 协作也可能增加 Token 消耗。

适合已经在用多个 AI Agent，希望统一管理、分工执行任务的用户。

👉 https://t.co/ou1WQNdvGQ - ahhhhfs
